items.title: Meta's Muse agent gains access to ad accounts and 15 business tools
items.excerpt: Small businesses in the US and Canada can now connect Shopify, QuickBooks and their Meta ad accounts to Meta's Muse agent. Nothing gets spent without the owner's sign-off, and the piece looks at what the agent is able to change in a campaign.

items.title: Olyzon's AI agents now shift CTV budgets across 4 DSPs in live buys
items.excerpt: Olyzon's agentic orchestration now moves CTV budgets between The Trade Desk, Amazon DSP, DV360 and Yahoo DSP in live buys. Buyers keep their own seats, and spend caps plus audit logs limit what each agent can do.

items.title: Brands can block YouTube ads beside AI slop under new IAS tool
items.excerpt: A new IAS tool lets YouTube buyers keep their ads off low-quality generative-AI channels. Exclusion lists refresh daily and are built from YouTube Data API signals that Google does not review.

items.title: Nestlé Mexico Had More Scale Than It Knew What To Do With – Until It Unified Its Data
items.excerpt: Nestlé Mexico used to handle data and targeting one brand at a time. After adopting the Treasure AI platform, it runs its whole portfolio's consumer data in one system and targets across brands. Caution: this reads like a vendor case study.
items.keyword: first-party data AI activation / AI audience targeting

items.title: Your Customer's Personal Agent Is Knocking. Is Your Business Ready to Answer?
items.excerpt: Personal AI agents like Meta's Muse and OpenAI's Dots now shop, book and handle returns for consumers. Salesforce's EVP argues that businesses have to decide whether to let these agents in or block them, and how to govern agent-to-agent selling. Caution: vendor blog.
items.keyword: conversational commerce AI / AI sales agent

items.title: “소비자 66%, 제품 찾을 때 AI 사용” 브랜드 검색, 소셜·AI·레딧으로 넓어진다
items.excerpt: An Emplifi and Semrush report (1,638 US/UK consumers) found that two in three have used AI to research products or find gift ideas. Product discovery is spreading from search engines to social, AI tools and Reddit, so brands have to show up across all of them.

items.title: Ad Industry Must Speak Same Language Before AI Takes Over: IAB's Jamie Finstein
items.excerpt: IAB's Jamie Finstein says the industry has to standardize what CTV, streaming and digital video mean before AI agents handle more media transactions. Otherwise today's confusion over what is being bought and sold will simply be automated.
